name: TraceSpatial-Bench
description:
TraceSpatial-Bench: An Object-Centric 3D Trajectory Planning Benchmark
  



  
    
  
   
  
    
  
   
   
    
  
   
  
    
  







Welcome to TraceSpatial-Bench, an object-centric 3D spatial trace planning benchmark provided by RoboTracer.TraceSpatial-Bench is the first benchmark that evaluates whether VLMs can perform multi-step metric-grounded spatial reasoning and object-centric spatial tracing in real, cluttered indoor scenes.


	
		
	
	
		🎯 Task Overview… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/JingkunAn/TraceSpatial-Bench.
reputation: A recent Hugging Face benchmark targeting VLM spatial reasoning with growing interest from robotics and VLM research groups but not yet widely established.
